meta_description: SJM Electrical and Plumbing in Sunderland. Expert electrical installations, repairs, and emergency callouts. Fast, reliable service. Call now for a quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault at home or work in Sunderland? We're out to you fast—same day in most cases.
services_subhead: From urgent fault diagnosis to full rewires and installation work, we handle all domestic and small commercial electrical needs.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, blown circuits, or faulty sockets? We diagnose and fix faults on the spot, with spares carried on every van. Available 24/7.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Older wiring causing concern? We replace outdated electrics to modern safety standards, minimising disruption and leaving you with a fully tested installation.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Gas boiler replacement and installation, complete with flue testing and safety certification. We handle the paperwork and all guaranteed work.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fuse Board Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuse boxes? We replace with modern MCB consumer units that improve safety, reduce trip-outs, and meet current building regulations.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't find the source of an electrical fault? We locate hidden problems using diagnostic equipment and advise on the safest, most cost-effective fix.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates (EICR)
services.desc: Five-yearly electrical condition reports for rental properties. We test all circuits and provide a formal certificate for your lettings agent or local authority.

about_pullquote: I started this because cowboys were charging my mates a fortune for simple jobs.
about_para_1: SJM Electrical and Plumbing was founded on a simple promise: honest pricing, no hidden charges, and work done right the first time. With over 15 years' experience across Sunderland and the surrounding area, we've built a reputation for showing up when we say we will, and leaving customers' homes safer and warmer than we found them.
about_para_2: We're Part P certified electricians and fully insured. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, our engineers carry most parts and tools on the van—meaning fewer return trips and lower costs for you. Word-of-mouth referrals make up the bulk of our work, which tells you everything you need to know about how our customers feel about us.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a blown circuit board and no heating in the middle of winter. Called SJM at 6pm on a Tuesday, and they were here by 7. Got the heating back on and fitted a new consumer unit the next day. Fair price, no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a full house rewire before we could get a mortgage. They quoted honestly, stuck to the timeline, and the whole job was clean and professional. Got our electrical certificate straight away. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out at 11pm for a fault in the loft. The engineer was friendly, found the problem in minutes, and explained exactly what needed doing. Cost less than I expected. Will use them again and have already recommended them to three neighbours.
reviews.author: David M.
